fields.description: The brand colour is used throughout the interface, not just on the header: it sets primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected rows, the sidebar selection bar and the active tab — everywhere Carbon uses its interactive colour. The header is configured separately below.
fields.label: Brand Colour

fields.description: Primary colour for the light theme. Leave empty for Carbon Blue 60 (#0f62fe).
fields.label: Brand Colour (Light)

fields.description: Primary colour for the dark theme. Carbon uses a lighter tone here than in light, because a mid-dark colour does not carry against a near-black background. Leave empty to lighten the light brand colour automatically, or Carbon Blue 50 (#4589ff) if that is unset too.
fields.label: Brand Colour (Dark)

fields.description: Carbon keeps its header near-black in both themes. Leave these empty for the Carbon default; hover, active, border and menu tones are derived from the background.
fields.label: Header

fields.description: Background of the top bar. Leave empty for #161616.
fields.label: Header Background

fields.description: Leave empty to pick black or white automatically, whichever reads better on the header background.
fields.label: Header Text

fields.options: Reload the page for changes to take effect. On a localhost bench the header is always amber hazard stripes, so a development site can never be mistaken for production; set carbon_dev_indicator in site config to force it on or off.
